en-US.description: Navicat BI Viewer is an easy-to-use tool for viewing BI workspace files.
en-US.longDescription: Navicat BI Viewer is an easy-to-use tool for viewing BI workspace files. With its friendly Graphical User Interface (GUI), Navicat BI Viewer allows you to navigate workspaces designed by Navicat's BI feature or Navicat BI. You can access local workspace files, or workspace files stored in Navicat Cloud or Navicat On-Prem Server.
en-US.name: Navicat BI Viewer
